notes: Mappings preserve the operator-provided capability labels literally.
The target model has one physical DisplayPort plus USB-C; whether reported DisplayPort-2 represents USB-C remains a hardware-qualification question.
Raw 0x19 is assigned to Thunderbolt-1 because the documented model inputs are Thunderbolt, DisplayPort, and HDMI and the latter two were explicitly mapped by the supplied enumeration.

limitations: Capability enumeration does not prove that a write succeeds or that readback verification works.
No OS version, backend implementation, EDID SHA-256, connector topology, write timing, switch-away result, or recovery test was supplied.
These mappings do not create a normal-runtime support record.
